data.text: I’m willing to take 6 tons this month so John and Kate can each take 12, with Jack and Emma taking 10 each. That totals 50 tons, leaving 50 to double back to 100. John and Kate would each earn $12,000, Jack and Emma $10,000 each, and I’d earn $6,000. I’ll keep my own catch at 6 tons this month. For later months, we could discuss rotating who takes the smaller share, but that would need a fresh agreement. Does this allocation work for everyone? John, would you be willing to take 12 tons under this proposal?
